# freshdesk_product (Data Source)

Look up a single product by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_product" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the product to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the product was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether new tickets fall back to this product.
- `description` (String) Description of the product.
- `name` (String) Name of the product.
- `primary_email` (String) Support address for the product.
- `updated_at` (String) When the product was last changed (RFC 3339).
